non-blocking: the added assertion compares the residual wall mask against a second call to _carrier_shadow_read, and because the single_null fixture mask digest is identical at base and head the assertion stays green when wall_height_shadow_mask is reinstated, so it characterises behaviour rather than guarding the deletion.

non-blocking: with shadow = private at :413 the "topological shadow excluded no private wall node below the X-point" guard duplicates the private_below check at :417 and can never fire, so it no longer reports anything about the exclusion.

non-blocking: the published legend still documents the qualified-saddle height band and wall_height_shadow_mask as the dark-band production rule, which benchmarks/poloidal_convergence_atlas.py no longer draws; the file is outside the node declared write paths.

non-blocking: the committed receipt lists flattened_static_state._wall_height_hysteresis among its compared fields, a state the operator no longer carries, so benchmarks/strict_exit_incidence.py can never reproduce that receipt; the file is outside the node declared write paths.
